title: Returns Desk Guidance: Crediting Returns Back to Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
**Rule.** When a purchase paid with a card of the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program is returned with a receipt, the part paid with the card is credited back to the same card where its type credits returns back to the same card, even if the card was depleted, which makes it active again; if that card is expired or canceled the amount is issued on a new Northgate Merchandise Return Card. The promotional-card portion of a returned purchase is handled under the type's promotional-portion term and is never refunded. A refund to a card never exceeds the amount the card paid on that purchase less earlier refunds to it.

## Where the credit goes, by the state of the paying card

| State of the card that paid | Credit for the card-paid part of a receipted return |
|---|---|
| active | credited back to the same card |
| depleted | credited back to the same card, which becomes active again |
| expired | issued on a new Northgate Merchandise Return Card |
| canceled | issued on a new Northgate Merchandise Return Card |

The promotional-card portion of a returned purchase is not refunded in any of these states.

## The ceiling on a refund to a card

The most that can be refunded to a card for one purchase is the amount that card paid on that purchase, less every earlier refund to that card for the same purchase.

**Worked ceiling (hypothetical amounts).** A Northgate Gift Card paid 80.00 toward a purchase, and part of the purchase was returned earlier with 30.00 refunded to the card. A later return from the same purchase can refund at most 80.00 less 30.00, which is 50.00, to that card. If the later return's card-paid part comes to 20.00, the full 20.00 is credited; if it comes to 60.00, 50.00 is credited.

## Illustration of the depleted case (hypothetical)

A Northgate eGift Card paid its whole balance of 25.00 toward a purchase and became depleted. When the item is returned with a receipt, 25.00 is credited back to the same card and the card becomes active again with a balance of 25.00.
